purpose: Independent DIE-owned behavioral parity contract for durable raster evidence before MUXIA implementation.

artifact.durability_rule: A success claim is invalid unless the artifact exists at verification time and its physical hash, size, and raster container agree with the receipt.

consistency: receipt artifact_path identifies the verified artifact
receipt sha256 equals physical artifact sha256
receipt bytes equals physical artifact size
receipt mime_type equals detected raster container

job_completion.rule: No success state may be accepted from status text alone. Durable artifact and matching receipt evidence are mandatory.
